component.name: Panaru
component.summary: Files in. Links out — file sharing with your Gokapi server
Files in. Links out — condivisione con il tuo server Gokapi

description.p: Panaru makes sharing through your self-hosted Gokapi server a single gesture: pick a file, get the link.
Panaru rende la condivisione tramite il tuo server Gokapi un gesto unico: scegli un file, ricevi il link.

ul.li: Multiple Gokapi servers, API keys stored in the system keyring
Streaming chunked uploads, even for very large files
Expiry, download limits and password per upload
Drag and drop, "Open with" from the file manager, link copied automatically
History synchronised with the server, delete from the server

description.p: No analytics, no third-party cloud: Panaru only talks to the servers you configure.
